hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Convert each number in arr1 to a string and insert all of its prefixes into a lookup structure set.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: For each number in arr2, convert it to a string and check each prefix from longest to shortest against the set.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Track the maximum length of any prefix found in the set.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Hash set of all digit prefixes from arr1 followed by lookup scan on arr2.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise digit comparison takes O(n1 * n2 * D) which exceeds 10^9 operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n1 * D) auxiliary set memory for string prefixes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use hash set of prefixes or Trie for linear time common prefix queries.
